propositions: The mapping block must be parsed as a reserved config section [tool.rebar.mapping] rather than routed through JiraConfig coercion, recognized by adding 'mapping' to _RESERVED_SECTIONS and read raw via read_reserved_section.

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) deep-merge per key across three layers (built-in ← default ← project-specific), with unnamed keys inheriting, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) replace wholesale most-specific-wins without union.

Configuration must validate fail-closed offline: every axis-map value must exist in declared vocabulary when declared, malformed blocks and non-string values raise MappingConfigError, and absent capabilities block axis references.

A provider-neutral Capability descriptor dataclass declares which mapping axes a target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities), distinct from backend operation Protocols.
The module mapping_config.py must import no adapters.jira* modules and contain no Jira value literals, preserving the one-way vendor-adapter seam dependency.
